# Claude Code stream fixtures

These messages are **built from the shapes in the Claude Code documentation** (the Agent SDK
reference and the non-interactive mode page, read on 2026-10-24 for Claude Code 2.1.310). They were
**not recorded** from a real run: no sign-in and no model turn exist in this repository. The
`subtype` of the permission request (`can_use_tool`) is an assumption that the documentation does
not state; the capability record lists it as unverified. A recording made by the owner replaces
these files.
